Class MetricClientImpl

java.lang.Object
com.eqixiac.equinix.core.client.ClientBase
com.eqixiac.equinix.core.client.ResourceClientBase<Metric, MetricJson>
com.eqixiac.equinix.fabric.client.internal.implementation.MetricClientImpl
All Implemented Interfaces:
Pageable<Metric>, PageablePost<Metric>, MetricClient<Metric>
public class MetricClientImpl extends ResourceClientBase<Metric, MetricJson> implements MetricClient<Metric>
Internal client for the Fabric Metrics search API (POST /fabric/v4/metrics/search). Standard POST-search paging comes from ResourceClientBase; since MetricJson implements Metric directly, wrap(MetricJson) is the identity.

ianjones

    • getMetricsByName

      public List<Metric> getMetricsByName(String name, String value)
      Description copied from interface: MetricClient
      Retrieves metrics by wildcard metric name (GET /fabric/v4/metrics). Only the wildcard metro metric types are supported by this endpoint (for example equinix.fabric.metro.*.latency). This endpoint does not support time-range filtering.
      Specified by:
      getMetricsByName in interface MetricClient<Metric>
      Parameters:
      name - the wildcard metric name (required)
      value - which value to retrieve (for example last; required)
      Returns:
      the matching metrics
